variants.name: Slugs
variants.info:
Changes your shot load to a slug, a single incredibly heavy and dense projectile.
Increased projectile speed, massively increased damage, improved damage to the head, and greatly tightened choke.

variants.name: #000 Buckshot
variants.info:
Changes your shot load to #000 buckshot, one the largest diameter pellets commercially available, perfect for hunting and for self defence.
Large pellets dealing high damage to enemies, with greater spread and penetration but lower pellet velocity.

variants.name: Bolo Round
variants.info:
Changes your shot load to a bolo.
Two large lead pellets joined together by a metal cable with incredible penetration potentional designed to rip through bodies.
High damage at range with very low spread but lacks in damage up close!

variants.name: 3½ Shell
variants.info:
Changes your shot load to 3½ inch buckshot shells.
8 pellets of #00 buckshot in a 3½ inch super-duper magnum shell packed to the brim with as much powder as you could possibly want.
Increases velocity making hitting targets in range easier. Yes, it's actually called a super-duper magnum.
